title: Expense Transaction Extraction — Output
description: Structured single-expense transaction record normalized from receipt, invoice, purchase-order, p-card, or general-ledger evidence. Input-normalization contract for the federal cost-allowability analysis workflow.

expense_id.description: Analyst or file reference for this expense.

source_document.description: What the record was read from (invoice number, GL line, p-card statement, etc.).

transaction_date.description: Date the cost was incurred, quoted in the document's format.

description.description: What was purchased or paid for, in the document's words.

amount.description: Charge amount as a JSON number with no currency symbol or thousand separators.

currency.description: ISO currency code. Defaults to USD when the document does not state otherwise.

cost_code.description: Project, fund, grant, or activity code the charge was booked to.

documentation_on_hand.description: Supporting records supplied with the expense. Empty array when none.

purchaser.description: Person who incurred or requested the charge.

project_role.description: That person's role on the project, when stated.

expense_category_hint.description: Apparent cost category when obvious from the description; null otherwise. Advisory only.

notes.description: Other reviewer-relevant detail, including reviewer questions and any secondary charges.
